# setup guide — placeholder-shaped docs, no live-shaped values
Set STRIPE_SECRET_KEY to the key from your dashboard (starts with sk_live_).
Your GitHub token is created at Settings > Developer settings (ghp_ prefix).
Export ANTHROPIC_API_KEY before running the agent.
Connection strings embed credentials as user, then password, then the host.
Never paste an AKIA-prefixed access key into chat.
Commit hashes look like d6f3bc253ef4 and are not secrets.
